name: json
title: JSON parse, read, and write
measures: Size: the library code a JSON program imports (RuneScript's std:json section vs the host's built-in JSON). Runtime (B08): parsing and serializing a generated document of n records.
notes: TypeScript uses the engine's native JSON.parse/JSON.stringify (C++ in V8); RuneScript's std:json is implemented in the language runtime on both targets, with checked reads. Expect TypeScript to win this one; the point is to measure by how much.
